classic-enchanting.midnightconfig.title: Classic Enchanting
classic-enchanting.midnightconfig.enchan:
A multiplier of 1.0 makes the max enchantment cost all 30 XP levels.
A multiplier of 0.5 would make the max enchantmnet cost 15 XP levels.
classic-enchanting.midnightconfig.enable: Grindstone gives more experience. Amount is automatically calculated based on the XP cost multiplier.
